_note: STA03 arrives after the run that produced before.json. Processing is sorted by corrected time, so STA03 (9.8) is processed FIRST: it creates a new evt-001 at 9.8, STA01 (10.0) then joins it (0.2 s <= 0.25 s), and STA02 (10.1) is 0.3 s from the new origin so it can no longer join and is left as a single-station event, which is rejected. Net effect: event_id stays evt-001, origin_time MOVES BACKWARDS from 10.0 to 9.8, and the station set changes from {STA01,STA02} to {STA01,STA03}. A late pick can therefore silently rewrite an already-published event rather than adding to it.
